div.p: Which 2-3-4 tree is formed after splitting both full nodes?

img.alt: A 2-3-4 tree. Root contains keys 10, 25, and 45. The root's left child contains keys 1, 5, and 9. The root's middle1 child contains key 20. The root's middle2 child contains key 30. The root's right child contains key 50.

Root contains key 25. The root's left child contains key 10 and right child contains key 45. Node 10's left child contains keys 1, 5, and 9, and right child contains key 20. Node 45's left child contains key 30 and right child contains key 50.

Root contains key 25. The root's left child contains keys 5 and 10 and right child contains key 45. Node 5 and 10's left child contains key 1, middle child contains key 9, and right child contains key 20. Node 45's left child contains key 30 and right child contains key 50.
